served_mismatch: Interpreting the requested timepoint as longest trial-reported follow-up, the served HR 0.72 (95% CI 0.64 to 0.82) applies to the interventional trial period with median follow-up 2.0 years. The held registry reports the overall-study primary composite through post-trial follow-up, up to 1869 days, as HR 0.79 (95% CI 0.72 to 0.87).

candidate_rejections.span: The primary outcome of kidney disease progression or death from cardiovascular causes occurred in 432 participants (13.1%) in the empagliflozin group and 558 participants (16.9%) in the placebo group (hazard ratio, 0.72; 95% CI 0.64 to 0.82; P<0.001)
candidate_rejections.why: Valid primary-composite result for the interventional period, but not the longest follow-up held in this packet.

notes: Registry spans are used because only the registry holds the longer overall-study result. This includes non-interventional follow-up; randomized treatment describes initial assignment. The registry's overall-study composite definition omits explicit ESKD and uses >40% eGFR decline, whereas the interventional definition includes ESKD and ≥40% decline. If 'trial end' means only the double-blind interventional period, the served estimate is supported.
